name: PawBoss
description: PawBoss: A Dog Day Care Simulation. Start with a small premises and build a business by balancing dog welfare, customers, staff, finances and expansion. Meet individual dogs and owners, respond to enquiries, prepare for inspections, develop your site and learn from the consequences of your decisions. Native iPhone and Apple Watch interfaces include VoiceOver actions, accessible premises controls, reports, optional audio and haptics. This early beta uses fictional businesses and gameplay assumptions; it is not professional animal-care, financial or legal advice.
whatToTest: Build 2: recorded dog, arrival, office, garden and rain audio; six full music tracks; all six volumes default to 50 percent and each sound has a preview. Please test the welcoming opening guide, three daily-priority pickers and revised Inbox. In Premises, activate a grid square to add an item, review its price and confirm. VoiceOver actions offer Add Item, Move and Remove; choose another square to finish a move. Check empty squares, fences, gates, floors and both starter rooms. Community and Market now offers three providers per category with distinct fees and effects over 30 game days. Test the larger dog/equipment range, savings and recurring costs, existing saves and real iPhone/Watch sync. Watch actions wait for iPhone confirmation. Please report unclear wording, focus, rotor actions, visual layout, audio balance or calculation problems with the screen and steps. Saves remain local and private; iCloud backup is not enabled. Complete Day advances game time.
reviewNotes: PawBoss is a fictional dog day care business simulation for iPhone with a paired Apple Watch companion. No login, demo account, purchase, advertising or subscription is required. Choose New Business, enter a business and owner name, and create the business. Office > Licensing, Strategy and Marketing and Premises provide startup controls. How to Play includes a searchable opening guide. Watch uses the iPhone business: open PawBoss on the paired iPhone, then use Refresh Sync on Watch if needed. Watch Menu opens eight management sections. The Watch queues actions while disconnected and waits for iPhone confirmation. Time only advances with Complete Day; notifications are optional reminders, not unattended real-time animal care. The iPhone target explicitly excludes iPad. All game characters and businesses are fictional. Audio and generated artwork are supplied with the app. Business saves are private to the device and are not bundled or shared with testers. iCloud backup is not enabled in this version. Please assess accessibility using native VoiceOver; no separate accessibility mode is needed.
